title: archanthemis calcarea var. discoidea
intro: Archanthemis calcarea var. discoidea, commonly known as Chrysanthemum, is a perennial plant belonging to the Asteraceae family, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and widespread cultivation. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and alleviating symptoms of colds and flu. Chrysanthemum contains therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
